quotes.topic: Method premise: deriving 3-part chords from 4-part chords
quotes.verbatim_quote:
What follows is a brief, introductory study of how to arrive at different 3-part chords
by leaving out one voice of a 4-part chord.
quotes.why_load_bearing: States the core generative principle of the entire chapter: remove one voice from a 4-part chord to produce a 3-part chord.

quotes.topic: Symmetry observation: each 3-part chord type appears four times
quotes.why_load_bearing: Encodes a key structural insight — the 4-part-to-3-part derivation system is symmetric.
